title: Check for duplicate label names in remote read response
body:
## Bug Report
**What did you do?**
Using remote_read and remote_write config, but Prometheus did not merge data from local storage and remote storage , i get two same points. so many function can't be used.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3701997/60559780-23973e80-9d80-11e9-86df-98072060bdd2.png)


**What did you expect to see?**
Prometheus should merge same points to one point.

**What did you see instead? Under which circumstances?**

**Environment**
   Start Command: /data/prometheus/prometheus --config.file=/data/prometheus/prometheus.yml --storage.tsdb.retention.time=2h --storage.tsdb.retention.size=2MB --log.level=debug

* System information:

	insert output of `uname -srm` here

         Linux 5.1.5-1.el7.elrepo.x86_64 x86_64
* Prometheus version:

	insert output of `prometheus --version` here

          build user:       root@a49185acd9b0
          build date:       20190525-12:28:13
          go version:       go1.12.5`
